properties.title: Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC) Collection of Treaty Texts
properties.description: The Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC) Collection of Treaty Texts consists of environmental treaty texts compiled in collaboration with the Columbia University Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN), United Nations Environmental Programme (UNEP), Tufts University Fletcher School of Law and Diplomacy (FSLD), British Columbia Ministry of Environment, Lands, and Parks (BCMELP), Antarctic Cooperative Research Centre (ACRC), and American Society of International Law (ASIL).
properties.sci:citation: Center For International Earth Science Information Network-CIESIN-Columbia University, United Nations Environmental Programme-UNEP, & Fletcher School Of Law And Diplomacy-FSLD-Tufts University. (2002). Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC) Collection of Treaty Texts [Dataset]. Palisades, NY: NASA Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC). https://doi.org/10.7927/H4251G48
